name: privatecode
description: Offline coding agent for your own local model. Your code never leaves your network.

chatParticipants.name: privatecode
chatParticipants.description: Ask your local model to read, explain or change this workspace

privatecode.serverUrl.markdownDescription: llama.cpp server URL. On a second machine use the model laptop's LAN address, e.g. `http://192.168.1.42:8080`.

privatecode.mode.markdownDescription: Default permission mode. `normal` asks before edits and commands, `plan` is read-only, `auto-edit` allows edits but asks for commands, `autopilot` acts unattended.

privatecode.devSmokeQuery.markdownDescription: Testing hook: when set, the chat view opens with this prompt already submitted at startup. Leave empty for normal use.
